contract.aggregation: micro precision/recall/F1 across classes at IoU 0.5
contract.best_tie_break: exact rational maximum F1, then precision, then recall, then higher owned score threshold
contract.matching: per-class globally score-ranked one-to-one greedy matching; ties by sample_id then frozen prediction_index; IoU>=0.5 is TP
contract.per_candidate_best_domain: only score boundaries observed in that candidate's own predictions
contract.prediction_population: already-stitched, class-aware-NMS outputs saved by the fixed 512/64 validation replay at adapter score>=0.20
contract.same_score_rule: all predictions sharing a score enter as one group
contract.scan_boundaries: exact IEEE-754 scores observed in either supplied prediction artifact; no rounding, interpolation, grid, or invented cutoff

interpretation_boundary.allowed_use: validation-only calibration evidence for a future, explicitly configured replay or pre-registered evaluation
interpretation_boundary.warning: The maximizing threshold was selected on frozen validation and is optimistically biased for that same validation population.

limitations: Predictions below score 0.20 were never saved and cannot be calibrated by this audit.
The sweep occurs after the fixed tiled replay and cross-tile NMS; it does not retune tiling or NMS.
Best-threshold metrics are validation-selected and cannot be treated as independent promotion evidence.
No test images, test truth, model inference, training, registration, or blessing is used.

major_class_selection.rule: top 10 validation classes by frozen truth support; ties by official_category_id then name
